ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Airolam Limited has submitted a routine regulatory filing to the NSE, confirming compliance with Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The accompanying certificate from their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India Pvt. Ltd., verifies that all securities received for dematerialization were processed correctly, including confirmation/rejection, mutilation and cancellation of physical certificates, and timely updating of the register of members. This document indicates sound corporate governance and efficient management of the company's share registry, with no red flags identified.
